claims.promise: Every class, student, category, assignment, mark, attendance record, note, contact and seat can be created, edited and deleted, instead of the incumbent's name-only editing.

evidence.finding: A 1-star review on the 100K+ app com.apps.ips.teacheraidepro3 names the gap verbatim: in the manage students and classes section the only editing you can do for classes is change the name, with no option to add or delete classes.

proof.assertion: Open RecordBookEditor.kt and count the mutations: the file declares add, update and delete for classes, students, categories, assignments, notes and contacts, plus setGrade, clearGrade, setAttendance and seat editing. Deleting deleteAssignment fails this gate.

claims.promise: A deleted class, subject or mark stays deleted and takes its dependents with it, instead of reappearing after the next look.

evidence.finding: me.yanu.gradebook is rated 3.3 over 21 reviews and a 3-star review states the defect plainly: cannot delete subject or grades, says deleted but reappeared.

proof.symbol: deleting a class removes it and does not bring it back
proof.assertion: Run the slot unit tests: deleting a class removes it and does not bring it back asserts the class is absent from the returned book, and deleting a category removes its assignments and their grades asserts the dependents go too.

claims.promise: The record survives daily use: a damaged file is preserved rather than overwritten, and a write that failed is reported instead of being claimed as saved.

evidence.finding: The 500K+ leader com.apolosoft.cuadernoprofesor is rated 3.6 and a 3-star review reports it is one error after the other with sometimes a forced close too, not for daily use.

proof.symbol: a damaged file is preserved rather than overwritten
proof.assertion: Run the slot unit tests: a damaged file is preserved rather than overwritten keeps the unreadable bytes on disk, a file that cannot be written reports failure instead of claiming success returns a failure, and saving leaves no temporary file behind.

claims.promise: Bought once and owned: a single non-consumable purchase removes the free limits, with no subscription to renew or cancel.

evidence.finding: A 1-star review on the 500K+ app com.apolosoft.cuadernoprofesor says if anything add one time purchase, and its developer replied in the same thread that one time lifetime payment for apps is reaching the end of life.

proof.assertion: Open values/strings_misc.xml: unlock_one_time_purchase reads one payment, this is not a subscription, and the same file states there is no subscription to renew or cancel. Removing the key fails this gate.

claims.promise: The whole record is a file the teacher holds, and restoring a backup brings back a class that was deleted after it was written.

evidence.finding: A 3-star review on the 100K+ app com.apps.ips.teacheraidepro3 says the reviewer bought it in the Amazon app store in 2014 and is scared to uninstall and reinstall from Play because the paid version would be lost.

proof.symbol: a backup restores a class that was deleted after the backup
proof.assertion: Run the slot unit tests: a full record round-trips through the backup format proves the JSON file is the whole record, and a backup restores a class that was deleted after the backup proves the file is a real restore rather than a one-way export.

claims.promise: The unlock is recoverable through Google Play on a new device instead of being stranded in the store it was bought from.

evidence.finding: The same 3-star review on com.apps.ips.teacheraidepro3 records the loss the reviewer fears after buying in a store that no longer ships on Android, which is a 100K+ app with 896 reviews.

proof.assertion: Open EntitlementController.kt: restore calls billing.restore and re-reads the entitlement so an owned unlock is reclaimed after a reinstall. Deleting the restore path fails this gate.

claims.promise: No account is created and no server of ours holds the teacher's data: the record never leaves the device unless the teacher exports it.

evidence.finding: The 500K+ leader com.apolosoft.cuadernoprofesor sells exactly this positioning in its own store description, private, offline and under your control, with student information not stored on the developer's servers.

proof.assertion: Read the manifest and the merged permission list: the app declares no account and no server, cleartext is forbidden through network_security_config, and the only network permission present is the one Play Billing's transport library adds for purchase traffic, which store/data-safety.md discloses rather than hides.
